stories.title: RBI keeps the repo rate at 5.5% (MPC, 1 October)
stories.body: a second consecutive pause with a neutral stance; FY26 GDP forecast raised to 6.8% (from 6.5%) and CPI forecast cut to 2.6% (from 3.1%); Governor Sanjay Malhotra.

one_liners: RBI keeps the repo rate at 5.5% (MPC, 1 October) — a second consecutive pause with a neutral stance
